limitations: Fixed present-day universe is survivor-biased; listing-time admission does not reconstruct delisted coins.
Spot OHLC plus funding/slippage proxies cannot validate exchange-specific fills or funding.
Historical OOS is chronological computational OOS, not unseen research history.
All 1944 nominal variant trials and their costs/delay/neighbor tests count toward multiple testing.

metrics.cagr: elapsed UTC days /365.25, net account equity
metrics.drawdown: worst event equity across conservative path; includes initial equity
metrics.log_growth: Each marked price/cost event log(Eafter/Ebefore), attributed to concrete asset and flat-to-flat episode; partial TP stays in same episode.
metrics.removed_trades: Subtract top three positive complete episode log contributions from total log growth, retaining dates; diagnostic omission, not changed capital allocation replay.
metrics.risk_stress: Re-run entire engine at 2x fees/slippage/funding and +1 entry bar. Fold selection remains frozen from nominal validation.
metrics.sharpe: daily sample SD; zero risk-free; sqrt(365.25)

oos_reporting: Each policy chooses parameters using earlier validation only. Fixed-grid OOS rankings are forbidden. The observed best among the 18 policies is a research comparison, not sealed proof. Pre-seal forward nominees are chosen using development metrics, never OOS outcomes.

parameter_neighbors.additional_finalist_replays: ATR, trail and TP thresholds multiplied by 0.8 and 1.2; momentum/vol also perturbed for six total per selector; no retuning or selection from neighbors.
parameter_neighbors.require: All existing axial adjacent grid points, same trend/risk family.
parameter_neighbors.similarity: Neighbor positive CAGR and >=70% center CAGR with DD <= center DD + 0.10. Stability = passing neighbors / all neighbors; all needed for high-return success.

reentry.confirm: Two rising completed closes and last close above EMA20 after stop, plus per-position cooldown. No refill during ongoing decline.

rotation.priority: New target immediately overrides old cooldown/TP/trailing state. Close old before opening new. CASH always allowed.
rotation.rank: Largest positive close/momentum-close minus one, eligible symbols only. Current position retained unless challenger score exceeds held score by 5 percent.

sealed.first_signal: After immutable finalist record; no retroactive signals or fills.
sealed.reason: Supplied repository history has been repeatedly inspected; no untouched historical seal claimed.

selection: Pareto on prior-calendar-year validation metrics only, with declared regime DD/exposure feasibility. growth: highest CAGR then DD; calmar: highest Calmar then DD; defensive: smallest DD then CAGR, requiring positive CAGR. No feasible positive candidate => CASH. Six partitions, three predeclared adaptive policies each. Parameter updates only on Jan 1. Warm starts do not carry hypothetical selection profits.

sizing.exposure_guard: At adverse continuous path crossing of gross notional/equity cap, exit; adverse opening gaps may breach cap and are flagged. Margin insolvency is recorded, never clipped into a healthy result.
sizing.increases: No averaging down: same-position increases allowed only above last add price and with confirmed rebound; no restoration after partial TP.
sizing.target: min(cap * .9, annual volatility target / realized volatility). Leverage above 1 only if BTC and asset trends healthy. BTC weak caps at .5; vol20/vol60 >1.3 caps .75, >1.8 caps .5. Risk-off trend => CASH.

timing.atr: Wilder 14 from completed bars; entry ATR frozen for TP/catastrophe; trailing updated from completed bars only; strictly monotonic.
timing.fill: Executable proxy spot daily OHLC; try O-H-L-C and O-L-H-C with preexisting thresholds and keep worse terminal equity; stop gaps at open; no same-bar reentry.
timing.missing: No forward-filled active prices; missing or nonpositive OHLC invalidates inputs. New asset eligible only after 252 observed closed bars.
timing.signal_available: Close D available at D+1 00:00:01 UTC; first subsequent captured daily open is D+2. Stress adds one bar.
